In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

an optimum concentration of Tb(1+)/Yb(1+) ions in the alumino-germanso-silicate glass fibers would facilitate the upconversion emission process from Yb3+ to Tb3+ and thus the observed green emission intensity would be maximized.
